failure_modes.recovery: Fix the named line item field — money is integer CENTS, tax rates are basis points (600 = 6%).
failure_modes.when: line_items_json is not a JSON array of valid line items (description, quantity, unit_price_cents; optional tax_rate_bps/tax_type/classification_code/unit_code)

description: Save a reusable line-item preset so a repeat invoice's items do not get re-typed. line_items_json is parsed and each item validated by the SAME checker myinvois_invoice_generate uses (description, quantity, unit_price_cents in integer CENTS, tax_rate_bps in basis points, tax_type/classification_code/unit_code against the LHDN code tables) and re-serialized canonically, so a saved template's items are always generate-ready. NEXT: myinvois_template_list to pull the items back out for a generate call.
name: myinvois_template_create
